passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.sa
passages.text: Valerius Martialis Prisco suo S.

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.1
passages.text: Scio me patrocinium debere contumacissimae trienni

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.2
passages.text: desidiae; quo absolvenda non esset inter illas quoque

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.3
passages.text: urbicas occupationes, quibus facilius consequimur, ut

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.4
passages.text: molesti potius, quam ut officiosi esse videamur; nedum

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.5
passages.text: in hac provinciali solitudine, ubi nisi etiam intemperan-

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.6
passages.text: ter studemus, et sine solacio et sine excusatione se-

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.7
passages.text: cessimus. Accipe ergo rationem. In qua hoc maximum

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.8
passages.text: et primum est, quod civitatis aures, quibus adsueveram,

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.9
passages.text: quaero et videor mihi in alieno foro litigare; si quid

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.10
passages.text: est enim, quod in libellis meis placeat, dictavit auditor:

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.11
passages.text: illam iudiciorum subtilitatem, illud materiarum inge-

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.12
passages.text: nium, bibliothecas, theatra, convictus, in quibus studere

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.13
passages.text: se voluptates non sentiunt, ad summam omnium illa,

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.14
passages.text: quae delicati reliquimus, desideramus quasi destituti.

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.15
passages.text: Accedit his municipalium robigo dentium et iudici loco

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.16
passages.text: livor, et unus aut alter mali, in pusillo loco multi;

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.17
passages.text: adversus quod difficile est habere cotidie bonum sto-

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.18
passages.text: machum: ne mireris igitur abiecta ab indignante quae

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.19
passages.text: a gestiente fieri solebant. Ne quid tamen et advenienti

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.20
passages.text: tibi ab urbe et exigenti negarem—cui non refero

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.21
passages.text: gratiam, si tantum ea praesto quae possum—, im-

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.22
passages.text: peravi mihi, quod indulgere consueram, et studui pau-

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.23
passages.text: cissimis diebus, ut familiarissimas mihi aures tuas ex-

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.24
passages.text: ciperem adventoria sua. Tu velim ista, quae tantum apud

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.25
passages.text: te non periclitantur, diligenter aestimare et excutere non

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.26
passages.text: graveris; et, quod tibi difficillimum est, de nugis nostris

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.27
passages.text: iudices nitore seposito, ne Romam, si ita decreveris, non

passages.label: Mart. 12.pr.28
passages.text: Hispaniensem librum mittamus, sed Hispanum.

passages.label: Mart. 12.1.1
passages.text: Retia dum cessant latratoresque Molossi

passages.label: Mart. 12.1.2
passages.text: Et non invento silva quiescit apro,

passages.label: Mart. 12.1.3
passages.text: Otia, Prisce, brevi poteris donare libello.

passages.label: Mart. 12.1.4
passages.text: Hora nec aestiva est nec tibi tota perit.

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.1
passages.text: Ad populos mitti qui nuper ab Urbe solebas,

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.2
passages.text: Ibis, io, Romam nunc peregrine liber

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.3
passages.text: Auriferi de gente Tagi tetricique Salonis,

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.4
passages.text: Dat patrios amnes quos mihi terra potens.

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.5
passages.text: Non tamen hospes eris, nec iam potes advena dici,

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.6
passages.text: Cuius habet fratres tot domus alta Remi.

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.7
passages.text: Iure tuo veneranda novi pete limina templi,

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.8
passages.text: Reddita Pierio sunt ubi tecta choro.

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.9
passages.text: Vel si malueris, prima gradiere Subura;

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.10
passages.text: Atria sunt illic consulis alta mei:

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.11
passages.text: Laurigeros habitat facundus Stella penatis,

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.12
passages.text: Clarus Hyanteae Stella sititor aquae;

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.13
passages.text: Fons ibi Castalius vitreo torrente superbit,

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.14
passages.text: Unde novem dominas saepe bibisse ferunt:

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.15
passages.text: Ille dabit populo patribusque equitique legendum,

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.16
passages.text: Nec nimium siccis perleget ipse genis.

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.17
passages.text: Quid titulum poscis? versus duo tresve legantur,

passages.label: Mart. 12.2.18
passages.text: Clamabunt omnes te, liber, esse meum.

passages.label: Mart. 12.3.1
passages.text: Quod Flacco Varioque fuit summoque Maroni

passages.label: Mart. 12.3.2
passages.text: Maecenas, atavis regibus ortus eques,

passages.label: Mart. 12.3.3
passages.text: Gentibus et populis, hoc te mihi, Prisce Terenti,

passages.label: Mart. 12.3.4
passages.text: Fama fuisse loquax chartaque dicet anus

passages.label: Mart. 12.3.5
passages.text: Tu facis ingenium, tu, si quid posse videmur;

passages.label: Mart. 12.3.6
passages.text: Tu das ingenuae ius mihi pigritiae.

passages.label: Mart. 12.3.7
passages.text: Macte animi, quem rarus habes, morumque tuorum,

passages.label: Mart. 12.3.8
passages.text: Quos Numa, quos hilaris possit habere Cato.

passages.label: Mart. 12.3.9
passages.text: Largiri, praestare, breves extendere census,

passages.label: Mart. 12.3.10
passages.text: Et dare quae faciles vix tribuere dei,

passages.label: Mart. 12.3.11
passages.text: Nunc licet et fas est. Sed tu sub principe duro

passages.label: Mart. 12.3.12
passages.text: Temporibusque malis ausus es esse bonus.

passages.label: Mart. 12.4.1
passages.text: Longior undecimi nobis decimique libelli

passages.label: Mart. 12.4.2
passages.text: Artatus labor est et breve rasit opus.

passages.label: Mart. 12.4.3
passages.text: Plura legant vacui, quibus otia tuta dedisti:

passages.label: Mart. 12.4.4
passages.text: Haec lege tu, Caesar; forsan et illa leges.

passages.label: Mart. 12.5.1
passages.text: Quae modo litoreos ibatis carmina Pyrgos,

passages.label: Mart. 12.5.2
passages.text: Ite sacra—iam non pulverulenta—via.

passages.label: Mart. 12.5.3
passages.text: Contigit Ausoniae procerum mitissimus aulae

passages.label: Mart. 12.5.4
passages.text: Nerva: licet toto nunc Helicone frui:

passages.label: Mart. 12.5.5
passages.text: Recta fides, hilaris clementia, cauta potestas

passages.label: Mart. 12.5.6
passages.text: Iam redeunt; longi terga dedere metus.

passages.label: Mart. 12.5.7
passages.text: Hoc populi gentesque tuae, pia Roma, precantur:

passages.label: Mart. 12.5.8
passages.text: Dux tibi sit semper talis, et iste diu.

passages.label: Mart. 12.7.1
passages.text: Toto vertice quot gerit capillos,

passages.label: Mart. 12.7.2
passages.text: Annos si tot habet Ligeia, trima est.

passages.label: Mart. 12.8.1
passages.text: Terrarum dea gentiumque Roma,

passages.label: Mart. 12.8.2
passages.text: Cui par est nihil et nihil secundum,

passages.label: Mart. 12.8.3
passages.text: Traiani modo laeta cum futuros

passages.label: Mart. 12.8.4
passages.text: Tot per saecula conputaret annos,

passages.label: Mart. 12.8.5
passages.text: Et fortem iuvenemque Martiumque

passages.label: Mart. 12.8.6
passages.text: In tanto duce militem videret,

passages.label: Mart. 12.8.7
passages.text: Dixit praeside gloriosa tali:

passages.label: Mart. 12.8.8
passages.text: 'Parthorum proceres ducesque Serum,

passages.label: Mart. 12.8.9
passages.text: Thraces, Sauromatae, Getae, Britanni,

passages.label: Mart. 12.8.10
passages.text: Possum ostendere Caesarem; venite.'

passages.label: Mart. 12.9.1
passages.text: Palma regit nostros, mitissime Caesar, Hiberos,

passages.label: Mart. 12.9.2
passages.text: Et placido fruitur pax peregrina iugo.

passages.label: Mart. 12.9.3
passages.text: Ergo agimus laeti tanto pro munere grates:

passages.label: Mart. 12.9.4
passages.text: Misisti mores in loca nostra tuos.

passages.label: Mart. 12.10.1
passages.text: Habet Africanus miliens, tamen captat.

passages.label: Mart. 12.10.2
passages.text: Fortuna multis dat nimis, satis nulli.

passages.label: Mart. 12.11.1
passages.text: Parthenio dic, Musa, tuo nostroque salutem:

passages.label: Mart. 12.11.2
passages.text: Nam quis ab Aonio largius amne bibit?

passages.label: Mart. 12.11.3
passages.text: Cuius Pipleo lyra clarior exit ab antro?

passages.label: Mart. 12.11.4
passages.text: Quem plus Pierio de grege Phoebus amat?

passages.label: Mart. 12.11.5
passages.text: Et si forte—sed hoc vix est sperare—vacabit,

passages.label: Mart. 12.11.6
passages.text: Tradat ut ipse duci carmina nostra, roga,

passages.label: Mart. 12.11.7
passages.text: Quattuor et tantum timidumque brevemque libellum

passages.label: Mart. 12.11.8
passages.text: Commendet verbis 'Hunc tua Roma legit.'

passages.label: Mart. 12.12.1
passages.text: Omnia promittis, cum tota nocte bibisti;

passages.label: Mart. 12.12.2
passages.text: Mane nihil praestas. Pollio, mane bibe.

passages.label: Mart. 12.13.1
passages.text: Genus, Aucte, lucri divites habent iram:

passages.label: Mart. 12.13.2
passages.text: Odisse, quam donare, vilius constat.

passages.label: Mart. 12.14.1
passages.text: Parcius utaris, moneo, rapiente veredo,

passages.label: Mart. 12.14.2
passages.text: Prisce, nec in lepores tam violentus eas.

passages.label: Mart. 12.14.3
passages.text: Saepe satisfecit praedae venator, et acri

passages.label: Mart. 12.14.4
passages.text: Decidit excussus, nec rediturus, equo.

passages.label: Mart. 12.14.5
passages.text: Insidias et campus habet: nec fossa nec agger

passages.label: Mart. 12.14.6
passages.text: Nec sint saxa licet, fallere plana solent.

passages.label: Mart. 12.14.7
passages.text: Non deerit qui tanta tibi spectacula praestet,

passages.label: Mart. 12.14.8
passages.text: Invidia fati sed leviore cadat.

passages.label: Mart. 12.14.9
passages.text: Si te delectant animosa pericula, Tuscis

passages.label: Mart. 12.14.10
passages.text: —Tutior est virtus—insidiemur apris.

passages.label: Mart. 12.14.11
passages.text: Quid te frena iuvant temeraria? saepius illis,

passages.label: Mart. 12.14.12
passages.text: Prisce, datum est equitem rumpere, quam leporem.

passages.label: Mart. 12.15.1
passages.text: Quidquid Parrhasia nitebat aula,

passages.label: Mart. 12.15.2
passages.text: Donatum est oculis deisque nostris.

passages.label: Mart. 12.15.3
passages.text: Miratur Scythicas virentis auri

passages.label: Mart. 12.15.4
passages.text: Flammas Iuppiter, et stupet superbi

passages.label: Mart. 12.15.5
passages.text: Regis delicias gravesque lusus:

passages.label: Mart. 12.15.6
passages.text: Haec sunt pocula, quae decent Tonantem,

passages.label: Mart. 12.15.7
passages.text: Haec sunt, quae Phrygium decent ministrum.

passages.label: Mart. 12.15.8
passages.text: Omnes cum Iove nunc sumus beati;

passages.label: Mart. 12.15.9
passages.text: At nuper—pudet, a pudet fateri—

passages.label: Mart. 12.15.10
passages.text: Omnes cum Iove pauperes eramus.

passages.label: Mart. 12.16.1
passages.text: Addixti, Labiene, tres agellos;

passages.label: Mart. 12.16.2
passages.text: Emisti, Labiene, tres cinaedos:

passages.label: Mart. 12.16.3
passages.text: Pedicas, Labiene, tres agellos.

passages.label: Mart. 12.17.1
passages.text: Quare tam multis a te, Laetine, diebus

passages.label: Mart. 12.17.2
passages.text: Non abeat febris, quaeris et usque gemis.

passages.label: Mart. 12.17.3
passages.text: Gestatur tecum pariter pariterque lavatur;

passages.label: Mart. 12.17.4
passages.text: Cenat boletos, ostrea, sumen, aprum;

passages.label: Mart. 12.17.5
passages.text: Ebria Setino fit saepe et saepe Falerno,

passages.label: Mart. 12.17.6
passages.text: Nec nisi per niveam Caecuba potat aquam;

passages.label: Mart. 12.17.7
passages.text: Circumfusa rosis et nigra recumbit amomo,

passages.label: Mart. 12.17.8
passages.text: Dormit et in pluma purpureoque toro.

passages.label: Mart. 12.17.9
passages.text: Cum recubet pulchre, cum tam bene vivat apud te,

passages.label: Mart. 12.17.10
passages.text: Ad Damam potius vis tua febris eat?

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.1
passages.text: Dum tu forsitan inquietus erras

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.2
passages.text: Clamosa, Iuvenalis, in Subura,

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.3
passages.text: Aut collem dominae teris Dianae;

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.4
passages.text: Dum per limina te potentiorum

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.5
passages.text: Sudatrix toga ventilat vagumque

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.6
passages.text: Maior Caelius et minor fatigant:

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.7
passages.text: Me multos repetita post Decembres

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.8
passages.text: Accepit mea rusticumque fecit

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.9
passages.text: Auro Bilbilis et superba ferro.

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.10
passages.text: Hic pigri colimus labore dulci

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.11
passages.text: Boterdum Plateamque—Celtiberis

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.12
passages.text: Haec sunt nomina crassiora terris—:

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.13
passages.text: Ingenti fruor inproboque somno,

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.14
passages.text: Quem nec tertia saepe rumpit hora,

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.15
passages.text: Et totum mihi nunc repono, quidquid

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.16
passages.text: Ter denos vigilaveram per annos.

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.17
passages.text: Ignota est toga, sed datur petenti

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.18
passages.text: Rupta proxima vestis a cathedra.

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.19
passages.text: Surgentem focus excipit superba

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.20
passages.text: Vicini strue cultus iliceti,

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.21
passages.text: Multa vilica quem coronat olla.

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.22
passages.text: Venator sequitur, sed ille quem tu

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.23
passages.text: Secreta cupias habere silva;

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.24
passages.text: Dispensat pueris rogatque longos

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.25
passages.text: Levis ponere vilicus capillos.

passages.label: Mart. 12.18.26
passages.text: Sic me vivere, sic iuvat perire.

passages.label: Mart. 12.19.1
passages.text: In thermis sumit lactucas, ova, lacertum,

passages.label: Mart. 12.19.2
passages.text: Et cenare domi se negat Aemilius.

passages.label: Mart. 12.20.1
passages.text: Quare non habeat, Fabulle, quaeris

passages.label: Mart. 12.20.2
passages.text: Uxorem Themison? habet sororem.

passages.label: Mart. 12.21.1
passages.text: Municipem rigidi quis te, Marcella, Salonis

passages.label: Mart. 12.21.2
passages.text: Et genitam nostris quis putet esse locis?

passages.label: Mart. 12.21.3
passages.text: Tam rarum, tam dulce sapis. Palatia dicent,

passages.label: Mart. 12.21.4
passages.text: Audierint si te vel semel, esse suam;

passages.label: Mart. 12.21.5
passages.text: Nulla nec in media certabit nata Subura

passages.label: Mart. 12.21.6
passages.text: Nec Capitolini collis alumna tibi;

passages.label: Mart. 12.21.7
passages.text: Nec cito ridebit peregrini gloria partus,

passages.label: Mart. 12.21.8
passages.text: Romanam deceat quam magis esse nurum.

passages.label: Mart. 12.21.9
passages.text: Tu desiderium dominae mihi mitius urbis

passages.label: Mart. 12.21.10
passages.text: Esse iubes: Romam tu mihi sola facis.

passages.label: Mart. 12.22.1
passages.text: Quam sit lusca Philaenis indecenter,

passages.label: Mart. 12.22.2
passages.text: Vis dicam breviter tibi, Fabulle?

passages.label: Mart. 12.22.3
passages.text: Esset caeca decentior Philaenis.

passages.label: Mart. 12.23.1
passages.text: Dentibus atque comis—nec te pudet—uteris emptis.

passages.label: Mart. 12.23.2
passages.text: Quid facies oculo, Laelia? non emitur.

passages.label: Mart. 12.24.1
passages.text: O iucunda, covinne, solitudo,

passages.label: Mart. 12.24.2
passages.text: Carruca magis essedoque gratum

passages.label: Mart. 12.24.3
passages.text: Facundi mihi munus Aeliani!

passages.label: Mart. 12.24.4
passages.text: Hic mecum licet, hic, Iuvate, quidquid

passages.label: Mart. 12.24.5
passages.text: In buccam tibi venerit, loquaris:

passages.label: Mart. 12.24.6
passages.text: Non rector Libyci niger caballi,

passages.label: Mart. 12.24.7
passages.text: Succinctus neque cursor antecedit;

passages.label: Mart. 12.24.8
passages.text: Nusquam est mulio: mannuli tacebunt.

passages.label: Mart. 12.24.9
passages.text: O si conscius esset hic Avitus,

passages.label: Mart. 12.24.10
passages.text: Aurem non ego tertiam timerem.

passages.label: Mart. 12.24.11
passages.text: Totus quam bene sic dies abiret!

passages.label: Mart. 12.25.1
passages.text: Cum rogo te nummos sine pignore, 'non habeo' inquis;

passages.label: Mart. 12.25.2
passages.text: Idem, si pro me spondet agellus, habes:

passages.label: Mart. 12.25.3
passages.text: Quod mihi non credis veteri, Telesine, sodali,

passages.label: Mart. 12.25.4
passages.text: Credis coliculis arboribusque meis.

passages.label: Mart. 12.25.5
passages.text: Ecce, reum Carus te detulit: adsit agellus.

passages.label: Mart. 12.25.6
passages.text: Exilii comitem quaeris: agellus eat.

passages.label: Mart. 12.26.1
passages.text: A latronibus esse te fututam

passages.label: Mart. 12.26.2
passages.text: Dicis, Saenia: sed negant latrones.

passages.label: Mart. 12.27.1
passages.text: Poto ego sextantes, tu potas, Cinna, deunces:

passages.label: Mart. 12.27.2
passages.text: Et quereris quod non, Cinna, bibamus idem?

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.1
passages.text: Hermogenes tantus mapparum, %26%27%27, fur est,

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.2
passages.text: Quantus nummorum vix, puto, Massa fuit;

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.3
passages.text: Tu licet observes dextram teneasque sinistram,

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.4
passages.text: Inveniet, mappam qua ratione trahat:

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.5
passages.text: Cervinus gelidum sorbet sic halitus anguem,

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.6
passages.text: Casuras alte sic rapit Iris aquas.

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.7
passages.text: Nuper cum Myrino peteretur missio laeso,

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.8
passages.text: Subduxit mappas quattuor Hermogenes;

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.9
passages.text: Cretatam praetor cum vellet mittere mappam,

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.10
passages.text: Praetori mappam surpuit Hermogenes.

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.11
passages.text: Attulerat mappam nemo, dum furta timentur:

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.12
passages.text: Mantele a mensa surpuit Hermogenes.

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.13
passages.text: Hoc quoque si deerit, medios discingere lectos

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.14
passages.text: Mensarumque pedes non timet Hermogenes.

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.15
passages.text: Quamvis non modico caleant spectacula sole,

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.16
passages.text: Vela reducuntur, cum venit Hermogenes.

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.17
passages.text: Festinant trepidi substringere carbasa nautae,

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.18
passages.text: Ad portum quotiens paruit Hermogenes.

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.19
passages.text: Linigeri fugiunt calvi sistrataque turba,

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.20
passages.text: Inter adorantes cum stetit Hermogenes.

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.21
passages.text: Ad cenam Hermogenes mappam non attulit unquam,

passages.label: Mart. 12.28.22
passages.text: A cena semper rettulit Hermogenes.

passages.label: Mart. 12.29.1
passages.text: Sexagena teras cum limina mane senator,

passages.label: Mart. 12.29.2
passages.text: Esse tibi videor desidiosus eques,

passages.label: Mart. 12.29.3
passages.text: Quod non a prima discurram luce per urbem

passages.label: Mart. 12.29.4

passages.text: Nec in Falerno colle maior autumnus,

passages.text: Intraque limen latus essedo cursus,

passages.text: Et in profundo somnus, et quies nullis

passages.text: Nos transeuntis risus excitat turbae,

passages.label: Mart. 12.57.27
passages.text: Et ad cubilest Roma. Taedio fessis

passages.label: Mart. 12.58.1
passages.text: Ancillariolum tua te vocat uxor, et ipsa

passages.label: Mart. 12.58.2
passages.text: Lecticariola est: estis, Alauda, pares.

passages.label: Mart. 12.59.1
passages.text: Tantum dat tibi Roma basiorum

passages.label: Mart. 12.59.2
passages.text: Post annos modo quindecim reverso,

passages.label: Mart. 12.59.3
passages.text: Quantum Lesbia non dedit Catullo.

passages.label: Mart. 12.59.4
passages.text: Te vicinia tota, te pilosus

passages.text: Hircoso premit osculo colonus;

passages.text: Hinc instat tibi textor, inde fullo,

passages.text: Hinc menti dominus periculosi,

passages.text: Hinc et dexiocholus, inde lippus,

passages.label: Mart. 12.60.1
passages.text: Martis alumne dies, roseam quo lampada primum

passages.label: Mart. 12.60.2
passages.text: Magnaque siderei vidimus ora dei,

passages.label: Mart. 12.60.3
passages.text: Si te rure coli viridisque pudebit ad aras,

passages.label: Mart. 12.60.4
passages.text: Qui fueras Latia cultus in urbe mihi:

passages.text: Da veniam, servire meis quod nolo Kalendis,

passages.label: Mart. 12.60.6
passages.text: Et qua sum genitus, vivere luce volo.

passages.label: Mart. 12.60.7
passages.text: Natali pallere suo, ne calda Sabello

passages.label: Mart. 12.60.8
passages.text: Desit; et ut liquidum potet Alauda merum,

passages.label: Mart. 12.60.9
passages.text: Turbida sollicito transmittere Caecuba sacco;

passages.label: Mart. 12.60.10
passages.text: Atque inter mensas ire, redire suas;

passages.label: Mart. 12.60.11
passages.text: Excipere hos illos, et tota surgere cena

passages.label: Mart. 12.60.12
passages.text: Marmora calcantem frigidiora gelu:

passages.text: Quae ratio est, haec sponte sua perferre patique,

passages.label: Mart. 12.61.1
passages.text: Versus et breve vividumque carmen

passages.label: Mart. 12.61.2
passages.text: In te ne faciam, times, Ligurra,

passages.label: Mart. 12.61.3
passages.text: Et dignus cupis hoc metu videri.

passages.label: Mart. 12.61.4
passages.text: Sed frustra metuis cupisque frustra.

passages.label: Mart. 12.61.5
passages.text: In tauros Libyci ruunt leones,

passages.label: Mart. 12.61.6
passages.text: Non sunt papilionibus molesti.

passages.label: Mart. 12.61.7
passages.text: Quaeras, censeo, si legi laboras,

passages.label: Mart. 12.61.8
passages.text: Nigri fornicis ebrium poetam,

passages.label: Mart. 12.61.9
passages.text: Qui carbone rudi putrique creta

passages.label: Mart. 12.61.10
passages.text: Scribit carmina, quae legunt cacantes.

passages.label: Mart. 12.61.11
passages.text: Frons haec stigmate non meo notanda est.

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.1
passages.text: Antiqui rex magne poli mundique prioris,

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.2
passages.text: Sub quo pigra quies nec labor ullus erat,

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.3
passages.text: Nec regale nimis fulmen nec fulmine digni,

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.4
passages.text: Scissa nec ad Manes, sed sibi dives humus:

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.5
passages.text: Laetus ad haec facilisque veni sollemnia Prisci

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.6
passages.text: Gaudia: cum sacris te decet esse tuis.

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.7
passages.text: Tu reducem patriae sexta, pater optime, bruma

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.8
passages.text: Pacifici Latia reddis ab urbe Numae.

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.9
passages.text: Cernis, ut Ausonio similis tibi pompa macello

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.10
passages.text: Pendeat et quantus luxurietur honos?

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.11
passages.text: Quam non parca manus largaeque nomismata mensae,

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.12
passages.text: Quae, Saturne, tibi pernumerentur opes?

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.13
passages.text: Utque sit his pretium meritis et gratia maior,

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.14
passages.text: Et pater et frugi sic tua sacra colit.

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.15
passages.text: At tu sancte—tuo sic semper amere Decembri—

passages.label: Mart. 12.62.16
passages.text: Hos illi iubeas saepe redire dies.

passages.label: Mart. 12.63.1

passages.text: Histra nec minus absoluta testa,

passages.text: Albi quae superas oves Galaesi

passages.label: Mart. 12.63.4
passages.text: Nullo murice nec cruore mendax,

passages.text: Sed tinctis gregibus colore vivo:

passages.text: Dic vestro, rogo, sit pudor poetae,

passages.label: Mart. 12.63.7
passages.text: Nec gratis recitet meos libellos.

passages.label: Mart. 12.63.8
passages.text: Ferrem, si faceret bonus poeta,

passages.text: Cui possem dare mutuos dolores.

passages.text: Corrumpit sine talione caelebs,

passages.text: Caecus perdere non potest quod aufert:

passages.label: Mart. 12.63.12
passages.text: Nil est deterius latrone nudo:

passages.text: Nil securius est malo poeta.

passages.label: Mart. 12.64.1
passages.text: Vincentem roseos facieque comaque ministros

passages.label: Mart. 12.64.2
passages.text: Cinna cocum fecit. Cinna, gulosus homo es.

passages.label: Mart. 12.65.1
passages.text: Formosa Phyllis nocte cum mihi tota

passages.label: Mart. 12.65.2
passages.text: Se praestitisset omnibus modis largam,

passages.label: Mart. 12.65.3
passages.text: Et cogitarem mane quod darem munus,

passages.label: Mart. 12.65.4
passages.text: Utrumne Cosmi, Nicerotis an libram,

passages.label: Mart. 12.65.5
passages.text: An Baeticarum pondus acre lanarum,

passages.label: Mart. 12.65.6
passages.text: An de moneta Caesaris decem flavos:

passages.label: Mart. 12.65.7
passages.text: Amplexa collum basioque tam longo

passages.label: Mart. 12.65.8
passages.text: Blandita, quam sunt nuptiae columbarum,

passages.label: Mart. 12.65.9
passages.text: Rogare coepit Phyllis amphoram vini.

passages.label: Mart. 12.66.1
passages.text: Bis quinquagenis domus est tibi milibus empta,

passages.label: Mart. 12.66.2
passages.text: Vendere quam summa vel breviore cupis.

passages.label: Mart. 12.66.3
passages.text: Arte sed emptorem vafra corrumpis, Amoene,

passages.label: Mart. 12.66.4
passages.text: Et casa divitiis ambitiosa latet.

passages.label: Mart. 12.66.5
passages.text: Gemmantes prima fulgent testudine lecti,

passages.label: Mart. 12.66.6
passages.text: Et Maurusiaci pondera rara citri;

passages.label: Mart. 12.66.7
passages.text: Argentum atque aurum non simplex Delphica portat;

passages.label: Mart. 12.66.8
passages.text: Stant pueri, dominos quos precer esse meos.

passages.label: Mart. 12.66.9
passages.text: Deinde ducenta sonas, et ais non esse minoris.

passages.label: Mart. 12.66.10
passages.text: Instructam vili vendis, Amoene, domum.

passages.label: Mart. 12.67.1
passages.text: Maiae Mercurium creastis Idus,

passages.label: Mart. 12.67.2
passages.text: Augustis redit Idibus Diana,

passages.label: Mart. 12.67.3
passages.text: Octobres Maro consecravit Idus.

passages.label: Mart. 12.67.4
passages.text: Idus saepe colas et has et illas,

passages.label: Mart. 12.67.5
passages.text: Qui magni celebras Maronis Idus.

passages.label: Mart. 12.68.1
passages.text: Matutine cliens, urbis mihi causa relictae,

passages.label: Mart. 12.68.2
passages.text: Atria, si sapias, ambitiosa colas.

passages.label: Mart. 12.68.3
passages.text: Non sum ego causidicus, nec amaris litibus aptus,

passages.label: Mart. 12.68.4
passages.text: Sed piger et senior Pieridumque comes;

passages.label: Mart. 12.68.5
passages.text: Otia me somnusque iuvant, quae magna negavit

passages.label: Mart. 12.68.6
passages.text: Roma mihi: redeo, si vigilatur et hic.

passages.label: Mart. 12.69.1
passages.text: Sic tanquam tabulas scyphosque, Paule,

passages.label: Mart. 12.69.2
passages.text: Omnes archetypos habes amicos.

passages.label: Mart. 12.70.1
passages.text: Lintea ferret Apro vatius cum vernula nuper

passages.label: Mart. 12.70.2
passages.text: Et supra togulam lusca sederet anus

passages.label: Mart. 12.70.3
passages.text: Atque olei stillam daret enterocelicus unctor,

passages.label: Mart. 12.70.4
passages.text: Udorum tetricus censor et asper erat:

passages.label: Mart. 12.70.5
passages.text: Frangendos calices effundendumque Falernum

passages.label: Mart. 12.70.6
passages.text: Clamabat, biberet quod modo lotus eques.

passages.label: Mart. 12.70.7
passages.text: A sene sed postquam patruo venere trecenta,

passages.label: Mart. 12.70.8
passages.text: Sobrius a thermis nescit abire domum.

passages.label: Mart. 12.70.9
passages.text: O quantum diatreta valent et quinque comati!

passages.label: Mart. 12.70.10
passages.text: Tunc, cum pauper erat, non sitiebat Aper.

passages.label: Mart. 12.71.1
passages.text: Nil non, Lygde, mihi negas roganti:

passages.label: Mart. 12.71.2
passages.text: At quondam mihi, Lygde, nil negabas.

passages.label: Mart. 12.72.1
passages.text: Iugera mercatus prope busta latentis agelli

passages.label: Mart. 12.72.2
passages.text: Et male compactae culmina fulta casae,

passages.label: Mart. 12.72.3
passages.text: Deseris urbanas, tua praedia, Pannyche, lites

passages.label: Mart. 12.72.4
passages.text: Parvaque, sed tritae praemia certa togae.

passages.label: Mart. 12.72.5
passages.text: Frumentum, milium tisanamque fabamque solebas

passages.label: Mart. 12.72.6
passages.text: Vendere pragmaticus, nunc emis agricola.

passages.label: Mart. 12.73.1
passages.text: Heredem tibi me, Catulle, dicis.

passages.label: Mart. 12.73.2
passages.text: Non credam, nisi legero, Catulle.

passages.label: Mart. 12.74.1
passages.text: Dum tibi Niliacus portat crystalla cataplus,

passages.label: Mart. 12.74.2
passages.text: Accipe de circo pocula Flaminio.

passages.label: Mart. 12.74.3
passages.text: Hi magis audaces, an sunt qui talia mittunt

passages.label: Mart. 12.74.4
passages.text: Munera? Sed gemmis vilibus usus inest:

passages.label: Mart. 12.74.5
passages.text: Nullum sollicitant haec, Flacce, toreumata furem,

passages.label: Mart. 12.74.6
passages.text: Et nimium calidis non vitiantur aquis.

passages.label: Mart. 12.74.7
passages.text: Quid, quod securo potat conviva ministro,

passages.label: Mart. 12.74.8
passages.text: Et casum tremulae non timuere manus?

passages.label: Mart. 12.74.9
passages.text: Hoc quoque non nihil est, quod propinabis in istis,

passages.label: Mart. 12.74.10
passages.text: Frangendus fuerit si tibi, Flacce, calix.

passages.label: Mart. 12.75.1
passages.text: Festinat Polytimus ad puellas;

passages.label: Mart. 12.75.2
passages.text: Invitus puerum fatetur Hypnus;

passages.label: Mart. 12.75.3
passages.text: Pastas glande natis habet Secundus;

passages.text: Mollis Dindymus est, sed esse non vult;

passages.label: Mart. 12.75.5
passages.text: Amphion potuit puella nasci.

passages.label: Mart. 12.75.6
passages.text: Horum delicias superbiamque

passages.label: Mart. 12.75.7
passages.text: Et fastus querulos, Avite, malo,

passages.label: Mart. 12.75.8
passages.text: Quam dotis mihi quinquies ducena.

passages.label: Mart. 12.76.1
passages.text: Amphora vigesis, modius datur aere quaterno.

passages.label: Mart. 12.76.2
passages.text: Ebrius et crudus, nil habet agricola.

passages.text: Multis dum precibus Iovem salutat

passages.text: Stans summos resupinus usque in ungues

passages.text: Aethon in Capitolio pepedit.

passages.text: Riserunt homines, sed ipse divom

passages.text: Offensus genitor, trinoctiali

passages.text: Adfecit domicenio clientem.

passages.text: Post hoc flagitium misellus Aethon,

passages.text: Cum vult in Capitolium venire,

passages.text: Sellas ante petit Paterclianas

passages.text: Sed quamvis sibi caverit crepando,

passages.text: Nil in te scripsi, Bithynice. Credere non vis

passages.text: Effugere in thermis et circa balnea non est

passages.text: Menogenen, omni tu licet arte velis.

passages.text: Captabit tepidum dextra laevaque trigonem,

passages.text: Inputet acceptas ut tibi saepe pilas.

passages.text: Colliget et referet laxum de pulvere follem,

passages.text: Lintea si sumes, nive candidiora loquetur,

passages.text: Sint licet infantis sordidiora sinu.

passages.text: Exiguos secto comentem dente capillos

passages.text: Fumosae feret ipse propin de faece lagonae,

passages.text: Omnia laudabit, mirabitur omnia, donec

passages.label: Mart. 12.82.14

passages.label: Mart. 12.83.1

passages.text: Omnes quem modo colei timebant

passages.text: Dicentem tumidas in hydrocelas,

passages.text: In thermis subito Neronianis

passages.text: Audemus saturas: Lucilius esse laboras.

passages.label: Mart. 12.94.8
passages.text: Ludo levis elegos: tu quoque ludis idem.

passages.label: Mart. 12.94.9
passages.text: Quid minus esse potest? epigrammata fingere coepi:

passages.label: Mart. 12.94.10
passages.text: Hinc etiam petitur iam mea palma tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 12.94.11
passages.text: Elige, quid nolis—quis enim pudor, omnia velle?—

passages.label: Mart. 12.94.12
passages.text: Et si quid non vis, Tucca, relinque mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 12.95.1
passages.text: Musseti pathicissimos libellos,

passages.label: Mart. 12.95.2
passages.text: Qui certant Sybariticis libellis,

passages.label: Mart. 12.95.3
passages.text: Et tinctas sale pruriente chartas

passages.label: Mart. 12.95.4
passages.text: Instanti lege Rufe; sed puella

passages.label: Mart. 12.95.5
passages.text: Sit tecum tua, ne talassionem

passages.label: Mart. 12.95.6
passages.text: Indicas manibus libidinosis

passages.label: Mart. 12.95.7
passages.text: Et fias sine femina maritus.

passages.label: Mart. 12.96.1
passages.text: Cum tibi nota tui sit vita fidesque mariti,

passages.label: Mart. 12.96.2
passages.text: Nec premat ulla tuos sollicitetve toros,

passages.label: Mart. 12.96.3
passages.text: Quid quasi paelicibus torqueris inepta ministris,

passages.label: Mart. 12.96.4
passages.text: In quibus et brevis est et fugitiva Venus?

passages.label: Mart. 12.96.5
passages.text: Plus tibi quam domino pueros praestare probabo:

passages.label: Mart. 12.96.6
passages.text: Hi faciunt, ut sis femina sola viro;

passages.label: Mart. 12.96.7
passages.text: Hi dant quod non vis uxor dare. 'Do tamen,' inquis,

passages.label: Mart. 12.96.8
passages.text: 'Ne vagus a thalamis coniugis erret amor.'

passages.label: Mart. 12.96.9
passages.text: Non eadem res est: Chiam volo, nolo mariscam:

passages.label: Mart. 12.96.10
passages.text: Ne dubites quae sit Chia, marisca tua est.

passages.label: Mart. 12.96.11
passages.text: Scire suos fines matrona et femina debet:

passages.label: Mart. 12.96.12
passages.text: Cede sua pueris, utere parte tua.

passages.label: Mart. 12.97.1
passages.text: Uxor cum tibi sit puella, qualem

passages.label: Mart. 12.97.2
passages.text: Votis vix petat inprobus maritus,

passages.label: Mart. 12.97.3
passages.text: Dives, nobilis, erudita, casta,

passages.label: Mart. 12.97.4
passages.text: Rumpis, Basse, latus, sed in comatis,

passages.label: Mart. 12.97.5
passages.text: Uxoris tibi dote quos parasti.

passages.label: Mart. 12.97.6
passages.text: Et sic ad dominam reversa languet

passages.label: Mart. 12.97.7
passages.text: Multis mentula milibus redempta;

passages.label: Mart. 12.97.8
passages.text: Sed nec vocibus excitata blandis,

passages.label: Mart. 12.97.9
passages.text: Molli pollice nec rogata surgit.

passages.label: Mart. 12.97.10
passages.text: Sit tandem pudor, aut eamus in ius.

passages.label: Mart. 12.97.11
passages.text: Non est haec tua, Basse: vendidisti.

passages.label: Mart. 12.98.1
passages.text: Baetis olivifera crinem redimite corona,

passages.label: Mart. 12.98.2
passages.text: Aurea qui nitidis vellera tinguis aquis;

passages.label: Mart. 12.98.3
passages.text: Quem Bromius, quem Pallas amat; cui rector aquarum

passages.label: Mart. 12.98.4
passages.text: Albula navigerum per freta pandit iter:

passages.label: Mart. 12.98.5
passages.text: Ominibus laetis vestras Instantius oras

passages.label: Mart. 12.98.6
passages.text: Intret, et hic populis ut prior annus eat.

passages.label: Mart. 12.98.7
passages.text: Non ignorat, onus quod sit succedere Macro:

passages.label: Mart. 12.98.8
passages.text: Qui sua metitur pondera, ferre potest.
